prerequisites.reason: Model performance can only be evaluated after training.
Understanding neural networks is essential for training them.
Benchmarking relies on evaluation metrics to compare models.
Evaluation metrics are needed to assess the performance of NLP models.
Understanding bias requires knowledge of how to evaluate model performance.
Divergence metrics are a type of evaluation metric.
Adversarial testing requires evaluation metrics to assess robustness.
Complexity in evaluation arises from the need to understand evaluation metrics.
